answer: I’m not aware of any other official OpenAI‑compatible endpoint that Ollama exposes for speech. The endpoint that lets you stream TTS audio on macOS is the **`/v1/audio/speech`** endpoint (the same one used by the OpenAI API for text‑to‑speech). When you hit that endpoint on the Ollama server and set the `stream` flag to `true`, you receive the audio data in a streaming fashion.
